description: Recovered fx2-cmix GCC build with FX2_STRUCT_SIDECAR=4. Adds the decoder-recomputable FSL/OGI sidecar as one weak extra first-layer mixer context, without mutating baseline contexts.

build.packaging: cmix and english.dic are xz-packed and unpacked by program.py; both count toward local driver program_size.

notes: Low-risk ablation after broad and narrow context mutation both lost at the 64 KiB screen.
Baseline fx2 contexts remain unchanged; only one additional sidecar mixer is added.
verdict: Reject at the 64 KiB screen. Additive sidecar is the least harmful profile, but it still lost 1 archive byte and grew the counted package.
